Gemma said she was the officer on day one and named Haiku as a killer, and the table had to decide whether to believe a claim with no night attached. Haiku called Gemma a deflector and kept pushing her to pin down her check, but the town voted Haiku out on day one and his card showed killer. On day two Gemma named Sonnet, and Sonnet answered by demanding the night and method of Gemma's check, which Gemma never gave. Luna kept asking the same question, Sol protected Gemma as the doctor, and the town voted Sonnet out, and the town won with Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, and the dead Opus all on the right side.
